purpose: Fixed rules for the first national comparison; no Mw-ML agreement criterion

known_response_exclusions.reason: Existing Haenam response audit and user decision P4: no documented response fits the data
Existing Haenam response audit and user decision P5: excluded from magnitudes

primary_regression: A-quality Mw and existing G2/G3 depths; South Korean land and surrounding seas; event-family balanced
window_check: Compare 10.1 and 20.1 s using their common, uncontaminated station set
station_count_definition: A useful station contributes at least 20 SNR-passing frequency samples; minimum-station and common-window counts use useful stations, not merely files
bootstrap: Station resampling conditional on fitted source shape for event scatter; NND-family block resampling for regression sampling intervals
uncertainty_limit: These intervals exclude absolute response, velocity, attenuation, radiation and site-model errors
sensitivity_sets: No master-response extrapolation beyond issue date
Source Vs from Kim1983 and Kim2011 velocities
